senses.gloss: c. (גנף, cmp. כָּנָף a. כַּף; v. אֲגַף) [bent, joint,]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 7:5">Zeb. VII, 5</cite> <he>שיבש גַּפָּהּ</he> (Talm. ed. 68ᵇ <he>שיבשה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) whose wing is withered.
Ḥull. 57ᵃ שמוטת גף a bird whose wing is dislocated.—Du. גַּפַּיִּם, גַּפַּיִּים.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:4">Ib. III, 4</cite> <he>נשתברו גַּפֶּיהָ</he> whose wings are broken, contrad. to <he>כנפ׳</he> wing feathers.

senses.gloss: arms, shoulders of a human being. Ohol. VII, 4 ניטלת בג׳ carried by her arms (put around the necks of her supporters); v. אֲגַף.

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 10:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. X, 5</cite>; a. e.—V. <cite ref="C00787"><he>גֵּיף</he></cite>.
